statement.zh: **标准**：安全设备标识（Secure Device Identity）。IEEE 802.1AR-2018 给网络设备定义 Secure Device Identifier（DevID）：一张绑定设备私钥的 X.509 证书。IDevID 由厂商在出厂时提供、全局唯一、防修改；LDevID 由本地管理员或域 CA 在设备入域时签发。DevID 的目标是让设备在没有用户登录的情况下，仍能用 EAP-TLS、BRSKI/EST 等协议证明“我是哪一台设备”。
statement.en: **Standard**: Secure Device Identity (安全设备标识).IEEE 802.1AR-2018 defines a Secure Device Identifier (DevID) for network devices: an X.509 certificate bound to a device private key.

statement.zh: 设备身份的核心不是证书文件名，而是私钥持有证明。IDevID 私钥通常放在安全元件，不能导出；LDevID 必须绑定到同一设备的 IDevID，否则把 LDevID 拷到另一台设备就能冒充。绑定关系用 IDevID 证书指纹/公钥与注册证明维持；验证方还要验证 LDevID 到域信任锚的证书链和吊销状态。
statement.en: Device identity is not a certificate filename but proof of private-key possession.The IDevID private key normally sits in a secure element and cannot be exported; LDevID must bind to the same device IDevID, otherwise copying an LDevID to another device would impersonate it.

statement.zh: 典型流程：厂商烧录 IDevID 与私钥；设备入域时向注册商出示 IDevID 证书，用 IDevID 私钥签 nonce/域标识；域 CA 验证后签发 LDevID；后续 EAP-TLS 用 LDevID 做设备认证。证书字段按 RFC 5280；设备序列号、厂商、型号可放 subject 或 SAN otherName；2018 版新增 ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 套件以对齐 Suite B。
statement.en: Typical flow: the manufacturer burns in IDevID and private key; at domain join the device presents the IDevID certificate and signs a nonce/domain ID with the IDevID key; the domain CA verifies and issues LDevID; later EAP-TLS uses LDevID for device authentication.Certificate fields follow RFC 5280; serial, vendor and model can sit in subject or SAN otherName; the 2018 revision adds the ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 suite for Suite B alignment.

statement.zh: 常见错误包括：把证书当授权令牌；只验 LDevID 不验 IDevID 绑定；忽略吊销与时钟；把 IDevID 私钥当普通文件拷贝；把 802.1AR 当 EAP 本身。802.1AR 只定义身份与绑定，不定义业务角色、访问控制策略或具体 EAP 方法；这些由 802.1X、RADIUS/AAA、BRSKI 与本地策略完成。### 形式模型。
statement.en: Common errors include treating a certificate as an authorization token, validating LDevID without the IDevID binding, ignoring revocation and time, copying the IDevID private key like a normal file, or treating 802.1AR as EAP itself.802.1AR defines identity and binding only; business roles, access policy and the EAP method are supplied by 802.1X, RADIUS/AAA, BRSKI and local policy.

statement.zh:
IEEE 802.1AR-2018 于 2018-06-14 董事会批准、2018-08-02 发布，替代 802.1AR-2009；2018 版增加 ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 签名套件，并对 IDevID/LDevID 证书字段与供应商信息做细化。IEEE GET 计划提供免费标准 PDF；后续 802.1AReg 修订仍在推进，不能把草案当现行。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：安全设备标识的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: IEEE 802.1AR-2018 was approved by the IEEE SA Board on 2018-06-14 and published on 2018-08-02, superseding 802.1AR-2009.The 2018 revision adds the ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 signature suite and refines IDevID/LDevID certificate fields and supplier information.
